name: @orplex/sdk
description: Framework-free core of Orplex Code: AI tool layer, MCP gateway, skills, plugins, cloud client, signed marketplace resolver

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/fix-esm.mjs && node scripts/write-pkg-markers.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-exports.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/files.test.mjs tests/marketplace.test.mjs tests/marketplace-index-v2.test.mjs tests/mcp-args.test.mjs tests/mcp-env.test.mjs tests/mcp-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/mcp-respawn.test.mjs tests/mcp-routing.test.mjs tests/tools.test.mjs tests/activity-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/loop-engine.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/verify-exports.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/files.test.mjs tests/marketplace.test.mjs tests/marketplace-index-v2.test.mjs tests/mcp-args.test.mjs tests/mcp-env.test.mjs tests/mcp-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/mcp-respawn.test.mjs tests/mcp-routing.test.mjs tests/tools.test.mjs tests/activity-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/loop-engine.test.mjs
